description: The provincial collection contains linear trails on Crown land and includes designated provincial trails. The latter include trail tread and a boundary of at least ten metres on each side to capture associated signs, parking and warming shelters. It supersedes the Glenbow Ranch Provincial Park and Fish Creek Trails datasets. The source says Public Land Use Zone maps take precedence in discrepancies, but those maps have not yet been updated for provincial trails, and users must follow applicable signs/notices.
